channel.title: Engineering Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of engineering blog posts from top tech companies

item.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to teach Copilot about your codebase
item.description: Learn how to add custom instructions and skills to your repository, use custom agents, and connect MCP servers like Playwright The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: How to teach Copilot about your codebase appeared first on The GitHub Blog.

item.title: Shipping Media Over QUIC at Meta Scale for Instagram Live Ingest
item.description: Meta has begun deploying Media over QUIC (MoQ), an emerging open protocol for real-time video streaming at scale MoQ will help simplify our protocol stack for live streaming video and enhance overall user experience for live video The post Shipping Media Over QUIC at Meta Scale for Instagram Live Ingest appeared first on Engineering at Meta.

item.title: Turning Opportunistic AI Inference Capacity Into Better Ads Recommendations
item.description: At Meta, we’ve built a system that enhances ads recommendations by leveraging idle inference capacity in our fleet Two elasticity levers in the system allow ads recommendation work to expand across opportunistic capacity, without compromising baseline performance The post Turning Opportunistic AI Inference Capacity Into Better Ads Recommendations appeared first on Engineering at Meta.

item.title: Filter, reshape, and redact logs before export with Transformers
item.description: Logpush now supports Transformers, allowing teams to filter, redact, and reshape log streams using SQL before export Powered by Apache DataFusion and Apache Arrow, Transformers apply those changes directly to log data before it reaches the destination.
